title: Use an alternate pronunciation cue
observableEvidence: Provides a reasoned response using supplied linguistic, contextual, or procedural evidence.
prompt: Two pronunciations differ in the first vowel: /ˈkoʊ.rəl/ or /ˈkɒr.əl/. What follow-up should the speller request?
solutionRepresentation: Ask which pronunciation the official expects because the vowel difference changes plausible spellings.
